title: code.query authoring is blind: no tree-sitter node-kind introspection
wanted_capability: Query authors can discover, on demand, the valid tree-sitter node kinds and field names for each language code.query supports, instead of guessing from examples. Two parts: (1) a code binding (for example code.nodeKinds({language}) or code.grammar) returning the named node kinds and field names of that language's grammar, read from the tree-sitter Language metadata the query path already loads; (2) per-language grammar guidance with example queries kept as retrievable guidance and signposted from the code namespace description, so query-authoring prose stops growing inline in the tool declarations. Part (1) must work in standalone harness sessions that have no Blackbox MCP surface.
missing_primitive: code.nodeKinds(language) binding + example queries in declarations
fallback_used: Abandoned semantic queries after 2 failed cells; fell back to a structural (function_item (visibility_modifier)) query plus code.read + JS string matching.
evidence: crates/bro-harness/src/bindings/code_facts.rs: CodeQuery (code.query) and the code namespace description in tools(), which carries the inline query-authoring examples and empty-vs-invalid note
crates/bbox-refactor/src/facts.rs: file_query, which resolves the grammar via chunker::code::ts_language_for_name
notes: Traced 2026-09-23: no node-kind or grammar introspection binding exists; the code namespace lists eight methods (items, fields, files, query, read, readLines, signature, spanUnion). Inline mitigations remain in the namespace description (two example queries, empty-vs-invalid semantics). No retrievable tree-sitter guidance memory exists.
